about: The global series set: an invented series as it stands on one day, and which next steps Fuzz should suggest in it (docs/series.md, "Suggesting new tasks"). Each kind of suggestion has a case where it comes out and a reverse where it mustn't: a stall with a reply owed and one without, a decision nobody acted on and one somebody did, a milestone nothing is getting ready for and one something is. Your part, mute, the weekly limit and a Not needed lesson each have a case too. Scored by `fuzz eval series` with no model, through series/suggest.py itself. Every case's "now" is a Tuesday in October 2026. Invented: nothing here may come from a real store.

cases.name: stall-with-a-reply-owed-nudges
cases.why: Nothing moved for over a week and someone owes a reply: suggest a nudge to them

cases.name: stall-with-nobody-owing-stays-quiet
cases.why: Quiet for over a week, but nobody owes you anything: a nudge would be to no one

cases.name: a-reply-owed-but-recent-movement-isnt-a-stall
cases.why: Someone owes a reply, but the series moved two days ago: it hasn't stalled

cases.name: a-muted-series-gets-nothing
cases.why: You muted it: no suggestions at all, however stalled

cases.name: driving-a-series-gets-follow-through
cases.why: You drive it, a decision was logged three days ago, and nothing has acted on it since

cases.name: a-decision-already-acted-on-needs-no-follow-through
cases.why: A task came after the decision: someone is already on it

cases.name: keeping-up-gets-only-what-lands-on-you
cases.why: You only follow it: the reply owed to you lands on you, a decision's follow-through doesn't

tasks.title: Get the ledger quote from Teo

cases.name: a-milestone-nothing-is-getting-ready-for
cases.why: Its go-live is in two days and nothing new in it is getting ready

cases.name: a-milestone-already-being-prepared-for
cases.why: Its go-live is close, but a task from yesterday is getting ready for it

cases.name: a-deliverable-due-soon-with-work-open
cases.why: Its deliverable is due in three days and two of its tasks are still open

cases.name: not-needed-twice-hides-that-kind-here
cases.why: You said Not needed to nudges in this series (a live lesson): a stall with a reply owed stays quiet

cases.name: no-more-than-the-weekly-limit
cases.why: A stall, a decision and a milestone all at once: still only two suggestions a week in one series

decisions.what: Ship Atlas without the beta flag

cases.name: a-step-on-a-rhythm-comes-round-again
cases.why: The same status note every week, three times, and this week's isn't started
